Alongside my research I take on a limited amount of consultancy — for research groups, hospitals, policy bodies and health-tech teams that need a statistician or methodologist for a specific piece of work.

:::: {.offers}

::: {.offer}
### Study & survey design
Sample size, choice of measures, and the design decisions that determine whether the data can answer the question.
[For teams about to collect data — a trial, cohort, survey or audit.]{.who}
:::

::: {.offer}
### Instrument validation & psychometrics
Factor structure, reliability, and measurement invariance for questionnaires, indices and rating scales.
[For teams building or adopting an instrument.]{.who}
:::

::: {.offer}
### Statistical analysis & modelling
Multilevel, survival and Bayesian models, and causal inference for observational data.
[For groups with data in hand and a decision to make.]{.who}
:::

::: {.offer}
### Simulation & health economics
Patient-flow and capacity modelling, agent-based simulation, and cost-effectiveness analysis.
[For managers and policy bodies weighing a change.]{.who}
:::

::: {.offer}
### Statistical review & second opinion
An independent read of an analysis — before submission, or after a reviewer's report.
[For authors, editors and teams who need a check.]{.who}
:::

::: {.offer}
### Training
Research methods and applied statistics for clinical and research teams.
[For departments who want to build the skill in-house.]{.who}
:::

::::

## How it works

An initial call to understand the problem, then a short written scope — the question, the approach, the deliverable and the timeline — and then the agreed work.

I work as a registered self-employed practitioner in Belgium and invoice accordingly. Rates are discussed at the scoping call.
